title: Andhra Pradesh and Chhattisgarh
subtitle: From the coast at Visakhapatnam and the hills of Araku to forest paths, stone temples and the waterfalls of Bastar.
location: Visakhapatnam · Araku · Kanger Valley · Dantewada · Barsur · Chitrakote

cover.alt: A rainbow in the spray below Chitrakote Falls, with layered cliffs above the green river.
cover.caption: A rainbow in the spray below Chitrakote Falls, with layered cliffs above the green river.

chapters.title: Rock arches and the afternoon sea
paragraphs: The journey begins on the coast, among weathered rocks and sandy hollows. Further south, a paraglider crosses the afternoon sky and shallow water gathers around barnacle-covered stones.

paragraphs: A viewpoint opens over the curving beach. Scooters line the promenade, and large Vizag letters stand above the water.
